english.note: Use this more formal noun when discussing the abstract quality of something being genuine, especially in certification or official writing.
Use this when correctness means that information or a statement conforms to the truth or facts.
Use 真實性 for the abstract quality or degree of being real, especially in formal or analytical contexts.

examples.english: The report needs to verify the authenticity of these artefacts.
examples.traditional: 報告需要驗證呢批文物嘅真實性。
examples.jyutping: bou3 gou3 seoi1 jiu3 jim6 zing3 ne1 pai1 man4 mat6 ge3 zan1 sat6 sing3

examples.english: The correctness of this information still needs to be verified.
examples.traditional: 呢個消息嘅真實性仲有待查證。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 ge3 zan1 sat6 sing3 zung6 jau5 doi6 caa4 zing3

examples.english: The reality of the claims in this report remains to be verified.
examples.traditional: 呢份報告嘅真實性有待查證。
